intro: The startup pivoted eleven times in a single quarter, and the engineers now speak to one another mostly through cryptic commit messages and the odd noise a chair makes. The glazed panel by the project room holds the previous roadmap under a sheen of coffee rings; no one is allowed to erase it, so the old plan has become part of the wall. In the corner, salvaged from a print shop, stands a type case whose drawers are arranged by the shape of the sorts, and every piece has a compartment that seems to have been cut for it alone. They keep their odd findings there—cable tags, badges, a single rollerball—without discussing why. The case is the one thing in the room that never argues back, and that is precisely why it survives every pivot.
echo: At the heart of every machine, and every nut, there is a small hard core.

puzzles.title: Hockey Stick
puzzles.flavor: Dressed overall, and saying far more than hello. Whatever you find, it was said on the way out, not the way in.

partials.035f54ca8b872cfbe6fa5df25256cbb365904028: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Ships carry a flag for every letter of the alphabet. Do you know them? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: All Hands
hints: A familiar grid puzzle in unfamiliar clothes. Once it's done, are some squares more important than others?

puzzles.title: Postmortem
puzzles.flavor: It never travels in a straight line, and neither does the truth. Whoever copied it out was standing in front of a mirror.

blocks.text: The knight sets out from f6: Ne8 Ng7 Nf5 Nh6 Ng4.

hints: Those are chess moves. Which squares does the piece land on, and what's written there? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Standup
puzzles.flavor: Everything that belongs is in there somewhere. Some things don't belong.

blocks.text: Somewhere in here: things to do with the office.

hints: Once every theme word is found, is anything left unclaimed? Read it in order.
The hidden words are: DEPLOY, LAMBDA, LATENCY, MERGE, SERIES, SPRINT, STANDUP.

puzzles.title: Offsite
puzzles.flavor: Fences and corners; some have an animal inside. Unlucky for some, and the same distance either way.

partials.290fa8a9f1b52efc8367156c3945ebbd04e09369: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Picture the alphabet written into a couple of #-grids and X-grids. Which cell would each shape be? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Runway
puzzles.flavor: Shredded, then sorted by a very tidy intern.
hints: The strips are alphabetised, not in order. The word lengths say where the breaks fall. Which strip could start the sentence?

meta.title: Meta: Series Z
meta.flavor: Pigeonholes, each cut to fit one thing only.
hints: The grid's rows are all different lengths. So are your answers.
